AntiPattern.Bad: Agent installs base Storybook, gets `storybook dev` running, and marks the ticket done without installing the test/MCP addon or registering the MCP server.
AntiPattern.WhyBad: Storybook present but unreachable by agents (`AX_SB_MCP_IS_MANDATORY`). Every subsequent component task must either rediscover props from source code or fall back to human-driven preview. The integration is structurally incomplete; calling it «done» misrepresents project state.
AntiPattern.Good: Install the recommended test/MCP addon (`STEP_SB_3_INSTALL_TEST_ADDON`), register the MCP server with the agent runner (`STEP_SB_5_REGISTER_MCP_SERVER`), and verify at least one MCP tool call returns a non-error response.
